thread:
OpsBot: Alert: elevated 5xx and per-token latency spikes in eu-west-1 observed across multiple pools. Auto-ticket created.
Samir Patel: Customers reporting slow gen and occasional 500s. Quick check shows sharp drop in kv cache hit rate.
Priya Shah: Verified: mcache-eu-*-pools showing eviction bursts. eviction_rate spiked ~8x at 16:45 UTC. cache_hit_rate down to ~60% from ~98%.
Jenna Liu: Rolling an immediate mitigation: disable prefetch and cap concurrent prefix requests to 8 on eu-west runtime via live config. Patch: `runtime.config.prefetch=false; routing.max_prefix_concurrency=8`
Marco Rivera: Canary apply on pod eu-r-43 now. Will watch errors/latency for 2m.
CS Team: Heads-up: sending preliminary note to a subset of affected accounts.
OpsBot: Canary completed: p=eu-r-43, no crash, visible improvement in hit rate.
Jenna Liu: Hit rate improved to ~85% on canary, 5xx down roughly 60%. Temporarily reducing batching size for top-affected models as extra mitigation.
Priya Shah: Automated fallback enabled for strict-SLO customers: route to quantized companion models if latency > threshold. Current fallback rate ~10-15%.
Marco Rivera: Pushing hotfix to throttle cache eviction under write surges (rev: a1b2c3d). Rolling to blue/green pools in eu-west.
Samir Patel: Drafting public status page update. Holding until full rollout verification.
StatusBot: Incident page created: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1791234567 (private notes redacted).
Jenna Liu: Monitoring: 10/12 pools returning to baseline error rates; token latency trending down.
Priya Shah: Next steps: 1) complete hotfix rollout; 2) assign postmortem; 3) coordinate follow-up comms with CS.
Marco Rivera: Hotfix rollout finished at 17:23 UTC. No additional eviction spikes after rollout.
Samir Patel: Impact classification: customer-visible but contained. Severity escalated S3 -> S2. Keeping channel open for 60m then preparing postmortem.
Priya Shah: Postmortem owner: Jenna Liu. ETA initial draft: EOD tomorrow.
OpsBot: Alert suppression note: repeat alerts suppressed at 17:30 UTC; will re-open if thresholds breach.
Samir Patel: Final internal status: mitigated; ongoing monitoring; customer comms pending review (CS to approve). Link to internal runbook: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/kv-cache-eviction
StatusBot: Prepared public message: "We experienced degraded inference performance in eu-west-1 caused by a cache eviction storm. Mitigations have been applied and service is restored for most customers. Further details and postmortem to follow." Waiting Samir approval to publish. :white_check_mark:
